title: Grip It Like You Mean It (Chas McIvor)
style: Bluegrass and country rock fusion. Banjo plays rapid, syncopated rolls throughout. Acoustic guitar provides rhythmic strumming and flatpicking fills. Upright bass plays a steady two-beat pattern on the root and fifth. Fiddle enters with energetic, melodic double-stops and slides. Drums feature a prominent backbeat on the snare with active hi-hat patterns. Male vocals are delivered in a gritty, spoken-word style during verses and melodic, harmonized singing during choruses. The tempo is a brisk 145 BPM in 4/4 time, likely in the key of G major.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[banjo roll, acoustic guitar strumming]
I say, I say son, pay attention now! C for cat, H for hat, A for apple, S for stupid. CHASE! [fiddle enters]
Now grab that club like you mean it, boy!

[Verse 1]
[upright bass and drums enter]
Ten fingers on the leather son, that's the overlap way
Left hand crowns the handle, right hand comes to play
Pinky of the right rides the index of the left
Grip pressure four out of ten, don't squeeze the life out yet
Not too tight, not too loose
Like you're holding a baby chicken son, don't you cook the goose

[Chorus]
[full band, vocal harmonies]
Grip it like you mean it, swing it like you breathe
V's pointing to the shoulder, that's the line you weave
Four out of ten son, four out of ten
Let the club do the work and you swing again

[Verse 2]
[banjo and fiddle trade licks]
Thumb pad down the shaft, a quarter inch from the top
Knuckles two and a half showing, that's where the good shots drop
Weak grip slices it sideways, strong grip hooks it home
Neutral's where you're living if you want to own the zone
I say son, why'd the golfer bring two pairs of pants?
In case he got a hole in one! Ha-ha! Now hush and grip the dance!

[Chorus]
[vocal harmonies]
Grip it like you mean it, swing it like you breathe
V's pointing to the shoulder, that's the line you weave
Four out of ten son, four out of ten
Let the club do the work and you swing again
That's my boy! That's my boy!
Grip pressure four, walk it back
Do it again. [banjo solo]
Do it again.
